full_judgment: 2. The land measuring 84.09 acres appertaining to CS plot No. 565 of CS Khatian No. 107 of Mouza Tejkunipara under Police Station Tejgaon at present Gulshan, District Dhaka was recorded in the names of Bhawal Raj Kumar Rabindra Narayan Roy Chowdhury and others. Out of 84.09 acres of land 3.41 was settled with the tenants in 1925 and the rest 80.68 remained with the Court of Wards Estate of Bhawal Raj. Subsequently, the government acquired 18.47 acres out of 80.68 acres for Dhaka Improvement Trust (now RAJUK) for construction of Tejgaon-Gulshan Road under LA case No. 55.58-59 which was notified in the official gazette. The requiring body, the then DIT, took possession of the land on 27-6-1960. Petitioner, the Bhawal Raj Estate, states that for the acquisition no compensation was paid to it. It is further stated that out of the acquired area 13 acres unused land illegally was released in favour of the so-called owner Abdul Khaleque Munshi and others by the DIT contrary to the finding of the High Court in Second Appeal No. 685 of 1970 which on appeal was confirmed by the Supreme Court in Appeal No. 84 of 1974 and possession was handed over to them on 2-4-1984. The petitioner has stated that for creating false and fabricated documents regarding the land belonging to the Bhawal Raj Estate many cases in Civil Court were filed and Abdul Khaleque and others also filed case in the civil Court and ultimately it was settled at rest by the decision of the Appellate Division against this petitioner and others. Thereafter, the petitioner took the matter to the Ministry concerned and it is stated that the Chairman of RAJUK was given responsibility to consider the representation of the Court of Wards in respect of 13 acres unutilised land. The petitioner states that it is pending decision by the Chairman.
